international.title: Nvidia board reportedly meets to decide CEO Jensen Huang’s future as chip giant’s share price plunges – follow live
international.summary: Nvidia shares plunge in extended trading, sending Asian markets lower Nvidia board reportedly deciding whether to oust CEO Jensen Huang Too big – and too well-connected – to sack? Huang does not enjoy the supercharged voting rights that are par for the course elsewhere – his shareholding is a plain vanilla 3.6%. On the other hand, Nvidia’s board does not appear to have spent much time worrying about succession planning and “key person risk” or other standard concerns of corporate governance wonks outside the US. international.title: Mississippi elects first Black Senator since 1874
international.summary: Democrat Scott Colom has won Mississippi’s Senate race, becoming the state’s first Black senator since 1874.
